newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore does not rule out more paging licences.
newsitem.headline: Singapore does not rule out more paging licences.

text.p: Singapore Minister for Communications Mah Bow Tan said on Wednesday it was possible the Singapore government would allow new players to operate paging services in the city state in future.
Asked by reporters if Singapore authorities would consider issuing more licences for paging services as it had done for mobile telephone services, Mah replied:
"Paging licenses: we don't rule it out but we have no plans at the moment."

Earlier Mah announced in a speech that the Telecommunications Authority of Singapore would call for tenders later this year to award up to two more cellular licenses for provision of services from April 2000.
